## Goal
What small fix or maintenance task needs to be completed?

## Description
Briefly explain what needs to change and why.

## Tasks
- [ ] Complete the requested change
- [ ] Verify that the change works
- [ ] Submit a pull request for review

## Definition of Done
- [ ] The issue has been resolved
- [ ] No unrelated functionality was changed

## Additional Context
Include any relevant files, links, or notes.
